Derate zone 0: lower setpoint to 35 °C (within 30‑58 °C) and limit heater output to 50 % to keep temperature well below safety limit and within regulation band, eliminating the 10.8 °C setpoint error.
Apply a -10.8 °C sensor offset for zone 0 to compensate the 10.8 °C deviation, bringing the measured temperature within the 1.5 °C regulation band while keeping all controller settings unchanged.
Maintain current operation; NORMAL mode allows no parameter changes. Monitoring continues as temperatures are within safety limits.
Regulation error cannot be corrected in NORMAL; safest action is to shut down all heaters.
